## How I checked it

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` (if I touched rendering, perception or UI)

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` ...).
- [ ] I added or updated tests for the behaviour I changed.
- [ ] Any new number, benchmark or claim in the docs is something I measured or can cite.
- [ ] If I added data: I recorded its source, product ID, resolution and licence in `docs/DATA_SOURCES.md`, and labelled what is real versus approximated.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` under "Unreleased".
- [ ] No secrets, personal email addresses or large binaries are included.
